set.body:
Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: F03.3
Program plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Core plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Accountable role (person unassigned): Backend engineer
Scope: Audit existing reads and supply reusable scoped predicates for new directory APIs.

Work kind: engineering
Acceptance gate: F03 (bd-01M4W40JJBE0KQ3K3H365X8033)
Suggested delivery tranche: T2; actual blocker graph controls readiness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Scope metadata/content reads, query predicates/results/counts, head/history/candidate/receipt lookup and collaborator suggestions by current authority.
2. Fixed-release recipients cannot discover a newer head; denied predicates/counts/errors do not reveal excluded data.
3. Provide authorized grant/effective-access inspection, including why access exists and expiry, without exposing unrelated identities or source evidence.
4. Include explicit source-evidence authorization and canary-based non-disclosure tests for raw/effective metadata, error shapes, links and result counts; authentication and curator attribution are not bypasses.

Verification: Cross-lab canary fixtures and negative API/query cases that compare visible responses as hidden data changes.
Expected evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/F03.3/receipt.json
Evidence fields: exact source/artifact and configuration identity; commands or human procedure and observed outcomes; fixtures/data scope and environment; acceptance-criterion results, negative cases and limitations; reviewer/acceptance evidence when the task requires institutional input

Source/contracts:
- modules/kernel/src/main/scala/sanctity/kernel/Authority.scala
- modules/postgres/src/main/scala/sanctity/postgres/PostgresCatalog.scala
- modules/integration/src/test/scala/sanctity/postgres/HttpSuite.scala
- docs/decisions/002-institutional-authority.md
- docs/decisions/institutional-authority-cases.json
- docs/core-hardening-plan.md

Blocked by:
- F03.2: bd-01M4W5P5GCCHC6ZMZ7MCGEJCW8

Completion: satisfy every criterion with source/artifact/configuration-bound observed evidence. Integrity, unauthorized disclosure, resurrected authority or false success block release. Local engineering and simulated provider/component-loss evidence do not close real institutional/provider/human/physical-host-loss gates. Existing completed work is not reopened or relabeled by this planning revision.
set.title: F03.3: Apply disclosure and effective-access rules to read surfaces
